line.en: Figures printed on thermal paper that rises out of a printer line by line on a dark counter, marked in blue ballpoint and torn off to move on.
line.zh-CN: 深色柜台上，热敏纸从打印机口逐行吐出数字，蓝色圆珠笔圈出重点，撕下纸条进入下一段。

for.en: Anything told as a list of names and figures: specs, prices, the parts of a whole and their total, ingredients, units side by side; short and playful explainers.
for.zh-CN: 能写成名目加数字清单的内容：规格、价格、整体的组成与合计、配料、并排对照的单位；轻松的短讲解。

not.en: Pictures, maps, mechanisms and stories: it holds only printed words and figures. Solemn subjects.
not.zh-CN: 图像、地图、机理和故事：它只有印出来的字和数字。严肃沉重的题材。
